high_condition: Below industry standards (poor fit-up, unsupported spans, excessive gap, misalignment)
medium_condition: Average construction quality with minor non-conformances
low_condition: High quality engineering construction with 100% verified support

high_condition: Poor corrosion management, active external pitting, loose/fretting clamps, degraded supports
medium_condition: Standard maintenance regime with minor paint breakdown
low_condition: Excellent corrosion protection, positive clamp tightness, active monitoring

high_condition: Repeating batch process, regular flow/pressure cycling > 1000 cycles/year
medium_condition: Occasional process swings / cyclic batching (100 to 1000 cycles/year)
low_condition: Steady state continuous operation with no cyclic swings

high_condition: 9 or more planned or unplanned shutdowns/trips/upsets per average year
low_condition: Fewer than 3 process interruptions per year
